thread:
Rae: Quick field-squad sync — we need to finalize the pilot rules for Optimize playbook (batching, cache, quant recs, eval alerts). Keep MVP conservative. Who can take what?

Samuel: I can own runtime-side heuristics for batching + a conservative guardrail: never increase batch size if per-request tokens < 32. Suggest default max batch=8 for alpha.

Isha: Eval side: we'll run concordance and labeled-quality delta. Proposal: require median quality delta <=1.5% and top-10 prompt concordance >=90% to mark a rec as "safe". Alerts fire when drift >2.5% over 7d.

Ben: Ops/customer asks: tenant opt-in is required. Dedicated customers also want a "review-by-ops" step before any apply. We'll implement "request-apply" that creates a ticket.

Clara: Console UX: card shows savings estimate (USD/month), quality delta estimate, and a small confidence meter. Include a compact preview of examples if alert triggers (respecting telemetry consent).

Rae: Can we define a simple canary for pilot? e.g., apply rec to 5% of traffic for 24h, monitor eval signals + error rates, then expand to 25% if no regression. Manual approval required for dedicated.

Samuel: Yes. Canary checklist: 1) traffic slice defined, 2) p50/p95 latency, 3) quality eval hook, 4) error rate bound (<=0.1% increase).

Isha: Alert config example for ops review:

```yaml
alert:
  id: "optimize.eval.regression"
  metric: "quality.delta"
  window: "7d"
  threshold_pct: 2.5
  sample_count: 200
  notify: ["sre", "pm"]
  attach_preview: true
```

Ben: Privacy: do not include raw prompts in exports unless tenant.telemetry_consent == true. Add export opt-in separate from recommendation opt-in.

Clara: Owners recap: Samuel -> runtime heuristics + canary implementation; Isha -> eval harness + alert thresholds; Ben -> ops/ticket flow + privacy; Clara -> Console UI; Rae -> PM + pilot coordination. Target alpha in 3 weeks.

alert-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-playbook/alpha -> staging at 3401234585 by @ci-bot

Rae: I'll draft a short spec with these bullets and share with the pilot customers. Ping here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
